Here’s a comprehensive guide of the key points discussed: 1. **Soft Body Simulation**: - Users can now enable soft body simulation for avatars by selecting the avatar and checking the soft body simulation option in the property editor. - A stiffness slider allows users to adjust the muscle definition of the avatar, ranging from fit (higher stiffness) to less toned (lower stiffness). - The soft body feature is compatible with all default avatars, and adjustments to avatar measurements should be made before enabling soft body. 2. **Elastic Updates**: - Elastic now includes presets for easier organization and application. - Users can drag and drop elastic from the fabric folder and adjust its properties, such as strength and pressure. - Elastic can be applied to garment edges using a binding tool, ensuring accurate grain line orientation. 3. **Modular Library Enhancements**: - A new modular library allows users to create and save custom blocks for garments. - Users can organize blocks into categories and easily create variations by using the style line tool. - The process of saving and managing styles and blocks has been streamlined. 4. **Animation Features**: - The animation mode has been updated to include camera animation and movement. - Users can create keyframes for camera positions, preview camera angles, and modify camera paths. - Preset camera motions are available for quick application. 5. **Avatar Updates**: - Three new realistic default avatars for men and women have been introduced. - The Avatar Editor is now more intuitive, allowing users to adjust measurements with automatic proportions. - New joint control features enable better posture adjustments, with symmetry options for joint movements. 6. **Curve Point and Reference Line Enhancements**: - The optimized curve point tool allows users to reduce unnecessary curve points in patterns. - New reference line functionality enables tracing and cloning patterns, helping to keep track of original designs. 7. **Grading and Print Layout Improvements**: - The grading process has been enhanced with new copy, paste, and mirror options for efficiency. - Print layout now allows setting fabric roll lengths, accommodating more accurate fabric markers. 8. **Colorway and Material Updates**: - The colorway editor now highlights selected top stitching and graphics within the 3D window. - Zipper components can be saved separately and managed within the BOM editor. - New color mapping options have been added to improve rendering results. 9. **UI Enhancements**: - Download options have been improved with a new list view. - Drag-and-drop functionalities have been updated for fabrics and trims, allowing users to choose how names are replaced. - Color palette and title menu updates enhance visibility and usability. 10. **Rendering Improvements**: - Removed the previous limitations on fur length for more realistic rendering. - Users can now import scenes and props together with their render properties for streamlined scene management. Overall, version 7.2 introduces numerous updates that enhance user experience, improve realism in garment design, and streamline workflows in pattern making, animation, and rendering.
